_comment: TNH LLM model registry — the ONE file to edit to change which models serve
which role. Nothing in the Modal app or the backend hardcodes a model id;
* modal_llm/app.py registers ONE Modal function per `enabled` entry, and
embeds this file into the image at /models-registry/models.json so a
deployed function knows its own role and sampler.
job-kind -> role -> primary model (then fallbacks), and to supply the
Changing a model means editing this file and redeploying:
python -m modal_llm.app urls   # refresh the URL manifest
`fallback` order is per role: first = primary, last = deepest backup. The
router only ever uses the first *reachable* entry, so reordering this list
is how you swap the primary without touching anything else.

scaledown_policy._comment: Thinking is NOT disabled: `--reasoning-budget 0` stops llama.cpp separating reasoning from content, which puts the chain of thought into `content` and shows it as prose. The default keeps it in `reasoning_content`, which the OpenAI-compatible reader drops. What DOES matter is the token floor — reasoning consumes max_output_tokens first, so a small budget returns an empty reply with no error anywhere.
scaledown_policy.idle_note: 60s at ~18s of model load. The image worker tolerates scaledown_window=5, so this is twelve times more generous already. Raise it only after measuring: every idle second of an L40S is billed.
scaledown_policy.container_shape: ONE container (max_containers=1), one llama-server per role on ports 8081+rp / 8082+util. util is a 12B specifically so both fit one L40S: two 31B models are 47.7 GB of weights and cannot share a card. `--swa-full` must stay off (~15.7 GB KV for Artemis).

rp._comment: Roleplay prose: in-character long-form writing, scene narration, continuations. Chosen for willingness and prose quality.

util._comment: Everything structured: image captioning, tool calls, memory extraction, summaries, image prompts. Sized to CO-EXIST with the rp model in one container: a 12B leaves ~6 GB of the L40S for Artemis's KV cache, where another 31B (47.7 GB of weights) cannot fit at all.

artemis_31b._note: Reddit's most-praised RP finetune; 1/30 refusals in one tester's bench. The only rp model with its own vision file, so it can read images directly.

writers_31b_v2._note: 'Goated' for long RP, slopless style, handles stat tables. Text-only — no mmproj in the repo, so this one cannot read images.

gemma4_31b_heretic._note: UGI 56.4, W/10 10, NatInt 35.6 — an abliteration rather than an RP finetune, so prose can read assistant-like. Shares weights with gemma4_31b_heretic_util (see dir), so this costs one download not two.

sompoa_26b_a4b._note: Fast tier: MoE with ~4B active. UGI Writing 43.5, NatInt 34.7.

weirdcompound_24b._note: Best all-round Mistral-family row: Writing 47.0, UGI 48.0, NSFW 7.8, Dark 7.5. Mistral Tekken template, not Gemma.

magnum_diamond_24b._note: Deep backup, the original pick. Low willingness (W/10 2.2) but high NSFW/Dark writing scores. gguf is a GLOB — its filename is unverified, so the first deploy will fail loudly if it does not match exactly one file.

dark_thoughts_v2_31b._note: BENCH. Best multilingual behaviour among the 31B finetunes — enable this if you roleplay outside English.

split_untied_31b._note: BENCH. Needs its own preset or it leaks English.

goetia_26b_a4b._note: BENCH. Highest UGI writing score of the bench (40.9, 47.9 with thinking).

styletune_v2_26b_a4b._note: BENCH. ~63 tok/s on a 16GB card per Reddit; speculation hurts RP on this MoE.

gemma4_31b_heretic_util._note: BENCH (needs its own container). Too large to co-exist with a 31B rp model: util primary. Same GGUF as the gemma4_31b_heretic rp entry (shared download), so NSFW extraction and captioning do not refuse. Vision uses the STOCK Gemma 4 projector on an abliterated model — works in practice but test with a real image.

gemma4_26b_a4b_heretic_util._note: BENCH (needs its own container). Too large to co-exist with a 31B rp model: Fast util. UGI 45.0, W/10 8.8. Its own repo ships the vision file, so no cross-repo projector.

mistral_small_32_it._note: Deep backup, the original util pick. More cautious than the Gemma 4 abliterations (W/10 6.5) but verified filenames.

gemma3_12b_heretic_util._note: util primary. Chosen for SIZE as much as score: 9.3 GB with vision (filenames and byte sizes verified against the HuggingFace API), which fits beside Artemis's 24.7 GB on one L40S. UGI 38.0 / W10 9.5 / NatInt 20.7 per the leaderboard rows. Most willing of the 12B class, and its vision projector ships in the SAME repo.
